name: Cairn-Wight

Traits.name: Running Water's Rebuke
Traits.text: While the cairn-wight is within reach of running water, the cairn-wight has Disadvantage on attack rolls and is Frightened unless it ends its move out of reach of the water; it cannot willingly cross running water.

Traits.name: Tumbling Cairn
Traits.text: When the cairn-wight moves alongside stone or earth, the ground it drags loose becomes difficult terrain for other creatures until cleared, slowing any who follow it.
Traits.clause: Whenever the cairn-wight moves along a Stone or earth wall, a pile of rubble, or natural rock, it can drag the stone dow

Traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the cairn-wight is subjected to Necrotic damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The cairn-wight has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The cairn-wight makes two Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

lore: A cairn-wight is a grave-marker that outlived its dead, piled stones steeped in a burial's grief until they stood up to keep watch and keep every passing traveler from disturbing what lies beneath.

generation.userConcept: a cairn-wight that cannot be harmed by steel and fears only running water
generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

lint_findings: orphan-condition-ref: "Frightened" is referenced as a state but nothing on the sheet applies it
